title: Enrollment Eligibility Note — One Open Blood Glucose Testing Supply Program per Customer
content:
A customer holds at most 1 testing supplies program at a time across every tier of the Blood Glucose Testing Supply Program, because a payer covers one meter and one strip allowance per beneficiary.

A new testing supplies program is opened only when the customer has no testing supplies program in referral received, pending authorization, active or on hold. A new meter, a treatment change or new insurance is written as a program change on the existing program, and a closed program does not count. The count is read from the customer's program records.

| Status of the customer's existing testing supplies program | New program may be opened |
|---|---|
| referral received | No |
| pending authorization | No |
| active | No |
| on hold | No |
| closed | Yes |
| none held | Yes |
